data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Moti is the name of the goddess of wealth, Lakshmi, who is symbolized by the pearl. The name Moti signifies abundance, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Moti carries the meaning “Pearl” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Moti usually hope their child will grow to embody pearl and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moti total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Moti holds significant cultural importance in Hindu society as it is associated with the goddess of wealth, Lakshmi. It is believed that invoking or calling upon the name Moti brings prosperity, abundance, and good fortune to one's life. The use of pearls, which are symbols of Moti, is also common in Hindu rituals and celebrations.
data.spiritual_significance: Moti holds deep spiritual significance as it symbolizes the divine mother goddess Lakshmi, who embodies wealth, fertility, and prosperity. In Hinduism, the goddess Lakshmi is worshipped as the goddess of material and spiritual wealth. The name Moti serves as a constant reminder of the divine Mother's presence and blessings in one's life. Wearing pearls or reciting the name Moti is believed to bring peace, happiness, and abundance to the emptiness of the heart.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Moti means 'Pearl' in Hindi. It symbolizes purity, wisdom, and wealth. A pearl is formed when an irritant enters an oyster, inspiring it to create a beautiful gem. Similarly, life's challenges can shape us into wiser, more valuable individuals.

historical_references.reference: Moti Dani was an Indian businessman and a pioneer in the Indian textile industry. He founded the Motilal Nehru Institute of Technology and Science (MNIT) in Jaipur, Rajasthan in 1964.

Moti Singh was a Sikh military leader who led the Sikh forces during the Siege of Lahore (1757-1765). He was the younger brother of Jassa Singh Ramgarhia and played an important role in the defense of Lahore against the Afghans.
historical_references.context: Military leader during the Siege of Lahore
